writing.overall_comment: This is a semantically accurate Swift skill reference with useful examples, but it needs failure-path coverage and more explicit actionable procedures.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately reflect Swift 6+ development across concurrency, models, tests, and macros, though '核心语言开发能力' slightly undersells the architecture-layer guidance.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: Examples show valid actor and Swift Testing patterns but cover only success paths and include a forced unwrap that conflicts with the stated best practice, with no failure-path or concurrency-edge-case examples.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: Usage triggers and best practices are concrete enough to guide code choices, but the document lacks step-by-step procedures or commands for resolving concurrency warnings and data races.

suggestions: In the code examples, replace the forced unwrap with safe optional binding so the sample aligns with the stated best practice.
In the Examples & edge cases section, add one failure-path example and one concurrency-edge-case example, such as actor reentrancy or cancellation handling.
In the Actionability section, add step-by-step procedures or commands for diagnosing and resolving concurrency warnings and data races.
